description: MPs who voted to legalize and/or expand MAID

death_toll.source: Health Canada 6th Annual Report on MAID (Nov 28, 2025)
death_toll.pct_all_deaths: 5.1% of all Canadian deaths in 2024 (1 in 20)

track2.key_finding: Non-terminal people killed due to lack of housing, disability support, and mental health care. Government expanded MAID then failed to provide alternatives.
track2.source: Health Canada 6th Annual Report on MAID (Nov 28, 2025)

provider_concentration.study: Canadian Medical Assistance in Dying: Provider Concentration, Policy Capture, and Need for Reform
provider_concentration.key_quote: The rapid increase in MAID likely reflects not a broad Canadian consensus but the capture of a policy-making and implementation process by a small group of activists and clinicians colonizing medicine to become an ideologically driven vehicle for expanding MAID access and delivery.
provider_concentration.significance: 102 doctors killed 6,185 people in one year. 38% of all MAID deaths by 5.5% of providers. This is not patient-driven — it is provider-driven.

compliance_failures.finding: Ontario regulators tracked 428 possible legal violations. Zero referred to police.

whistleblower_reports.name: Roger Foley
whistleblower_reports.report: Hospital staff withheld food and water and suggested MAID four times

whistleblower_reports.name: Heather Hancock
whistleblower_reports.report: Nurse called her selfish for declining MAID, said she was consuming resources

whistleblower_reports.name: Anonymous 84-year-old (Vancouver)
whistleblower_reports.report: Doctor suggested MAID before diagnostic tests completed. Patient made full recovery.

provincial_concentration.key_finding: Quebec has the highest MAID rate in the world at 67 per 100,000. Three provinces account for 85% of all deaths.
provincial_concentration.cross_reference_providers: 102 high-volume providers likely concentrated in Quebec and Ontario where volume is highest
provincial_concentration.source: Health Canada 6th Annual Report on MAID (Nov 2025)

fiscal_motive.source_pbo: Parliamentary Budget Officer, Cost Estimate for Bill C-7 (Oct 2020)
fiscal_motive.source_academic: Government Economics of Expanding MAID, Jamil & Pearce, 2025 (SAGE)
fiscal_motive.key_finding: The government calculated MAID would save $149M/year BEFORE voting to expand it. Projected savings of $1.273 TRILLION by 2047. MAID is fiscal policy disguised as compassion.
fiscal_motive.ethical_concern: Financially incentivizing MAID shifts healthcare priorities away from providing support, devaluing vulnerable lives and fostering reliance on assisted death as an economic solution.
fiscal_motive.un_criticism: UN human rights experts condemned the program for lacking safeguards and devaluing disabled lives.

track2_mental_illness.bill_c218: The Right to Recover Act — MP Tamara Jansen (CPC). Second reading vote expected April 13-17, 2026. Needs 24 Liberal MPs to cross floor. Liberals and Bloc signalled opposition.
track2_mental_illness.alberta_bill18: Alberta Bill 18 (March 18, 2026) — provincially prohibit MAID for mental illness as sole condition, limit to patients likely to die within 12 months

charter_challenges.plaintiffs: Inclusion Canada, Council of Canadians with Disabilities
charter_challenges.claim: Track 2 unconstitutional discrimination against disabled persons

charter_challenges.case: Dying With Dignity v. religious hospital exemptions
charter_challenges.claim: Catholic hospitals refusing MAID on-site violates Charter
charter_challenges.catalyst: Sam O'Neill (age 34, terminal cancer) forced to transfer from St. Paul's Hospital Vancouver

un_criticism_detail.body: UN Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities
un_criticism_detail.recommendation: Repeal Track 2 entirely, including 2027 mental illness expansion
un_criticism_detail.canada_response: No plans to act on UN recommendations

veterans_maid.kelsi_sheren_testimony: 20 veterans have documented proof of being offered MAID when seeking healthcare, with audio recordings
veterans_maid.discrepancy: Official report found 4 cases (single employee). Veteran testimony claims 20+ with evidence. Discrepancy unresolved.
